scope: Successful Lock opens the native Pull options workflow at batch completion for standalone Locks, Commit and Working Tree. Full port remains incomplete.

verification.native: Complete activation-prohibited receiver passed Apple Git and bundled Git. Standalone actual controller callback verifies nonbusy completed batch and still-attached results sheet, creates actual native Pull controller with same repository/executable, private preferences, Pull title and native controls, loads local options, verifies no Pull/Fetch progress started and closes it. Two-file successful Lock produces exactly one callback; mixed per-file failure, cancelled batch, cancelled token despite noncancelled injected batch, thrown error and successful Unlock produce none. Close does not repeat the callback. Production Commit/Working Tree owner handlers dispatch successful Lock while their owned LFS progress remains attached and parent stays busy; both open actual Pull options controllers, while failed Unlock and Force Unlock do not. Existing Locks path-memory/scroll/layout/clipboard/Force/Close-refresh/cancellation, Commit/Working Tree owner-column and Resolve/HEAD/raw-index/tracked-byte checks retained and pass. LFS replies injected; no network transport submitted.
verification.routing: RepositoryModel wires all three owner callbacks to existing showFetch(isPull:true) with captured repository and access, preserving established Pull progress and post-action handling. This wiring is inspected/compiled; native receiver instantiates real owner and Pull controllers with private callbacks, not the complete visible RepositoryModel route.
verification.debug: Debug build and bundle audit pass.
verification.store: Sequential unsigned AppStore build and required Git/Git LFS bundle audit pass. Both Debug/Store packages contain current NOTICE. Sources/NOTICE/receivers frozen while compiler/native handles live.
verification.inventory: Pinned inventory and diff checks pass; six mappings remain partial.
verification.site: Local Pages generation passes with updated guide and QA; no deployment or fresh screenshot claim.

limitations: Visible activation, physical interaction, appearance/accessibility/fresh screenshots and authenticated LFS/Pull transport remain unverified.
Native private callbacks validate controller routing; complete visible RepositoryModel dispatch and signed security-scope handoff remain unverified.
Full progress/dialog/menu parity, signed Finder/sandbox deployment, App Store acceptance, GitHub CI/push and full application port remain incomplete.
